## Analysis

The lone run is valid but far below the 1.144887 reference, so the 17-element seed is only a starting point, not the reference-quality SimpleTES construction. Its compact span (29) makes exact local search cheap. Affine transformations cannot improve the score, and digit-product constructions preserve the exponent, so effort should target genuinely new additive structure. No mutation strategy or larger cardinality has yet been tested; nothing supports abandoning this lineage.

## Next

Implement a 165-second simulated-annealing search initialized from `sol_0000`: use `restarts=48`, allow `n∈[12,32]`, and mutate by replacing, adding, or deleting one element within `[-128,128]`, scoring exact enumerated sum/difference sets. Use `T0=0.01`, exponential cooling to `1e-6`, retain the global best, and write it after every improvement plus a final safety write.
